contract: TASK-120 error codes and audit allowlist (plan §5.3, S14)
error_body_rule: Bodies never contain hidden counts, names or identifiers.
audit_safe_metadata: allowlisted ids, codes, profile and outcome only; no key, secret, reason text or report content

authority_model.policy: proposer and activator are different active administrators holding active POLICY authority (D2)
authority_model.full_key: requester and approver are different active administrators holding active INTEGRATION authority (D5)
authority_model.S2: an administrator cannot reset the password of, change the role of, or deactivate an account holding active AdminAuthority -> 403 AUTHORITY_PROTECTED; holders may change their own password; recovery and disabling are local-operator actions
